blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Boholanos on Wednesday paid tribute to the late President Carlos P. Garcia on his 130th birth anniversary, honoring his legacy of patriotism and contributions to the country. The provincial government held a wreath-laying ceremony and commemorative program at the Bohol Provincial Capitol as part of its annual observance of the birth anniversary of its most illustrious son. Garcia, the eighth president of the Philippines, was born on November 4, 1896, in Talibon, Bohol. READ: Bohol marks President Carlos P.
